record.kind: Inline check in PokemonState.updateEachSecond (once per second); no PassiveEffects entry
record.summary: Passive.ILLUMISE_VOLBEAT has no PassiveEffects entry; its only reader is a block in PokemonState.updateEachSecond. Once per second (each time the unit's oneSecondCooldown has run out), a unit whose passive is ILLUMISE_VOLBEAT scans the whole board (Board.forEach covers every cell, both teams) and, for every OTHER entity whose passive is also ILLUMISE_VOLBEAT, calls addPP(5, self, 0, false). Requested amount 5 PP per matching other unit per second, on top of the ordinary passive PP of 10 per second and weather/effect PP from the same function. addPP (section J3): amount = round(5 x fatigue factor 0.5 if fatigued) (so 3 under fatigue: Math.round(2.5) = 3), Twist Band irrelevant for a positive value, the gain is dropped when the unit is silenced, has status.protect (Rune Protect alone does not block), has NO_PP_GAIN, or is resurrecting; the new pp is clamped to 0..2 x maxPP - 1 (179 for maxPP 90). Because the scan does not test team, a matching unit on the opposing team counts the same as a partner; because the only condition is the passive, both Illumise and Volbeat (and any other unit carrying the passive) count, but the unit itself does not. With one partner the gain is 5/s, with two others 10/s, etc.
triggers: PokemonState.update -> updateEachSecond, every 1000 ms of the entity's own timer

effects.declaredRaw: +5 PP per second for each other board unit with passive ILLUMISE_VOLBEAT
effects.scaling: flat 5 per match, apBoost 0, no crit; fatigue halves a positive request (rounded, 5 -> 3); no stat scaling
effects.resolution: requested 5 per match; applied = value after fatigue rounding, then dropped entirely if silence / status.protect / NO_PP_GAIN / resurrecting, else pp = clamp(pp + value, 0, 2 x maxPP - 1). Each match is a separate addPP call, so the guards are evaluated per call and the 2 x maxPP - 1 clamp can cut the last one.

conditions: at least one other entity on the board (any team) has the same passive
record.resetBehaviour: No state kept; the gain stops when no other matching entity occupies a cell. Whether a KO'd entity is removed from its cell immediately (so it stops counting) was not traced.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Whether KO'd entities leave their board cell before the next second tick was not traced
